title: Supreme Court stays third-country-removal ruling and takes the case
adds: The Supreme Court on September 29 stayed the February 25 judgment against DHS's third-country-removal guidance and agreed to hear the case in December. The stay suspends the judgment while review continues; it does not decide whether the guidance is lawful.
contribution_scope: Reviewed navigation description; read each source for its own claim and clock.
navigation_contribution: Follow the third-country-removal guidance through the TRO, judgment, appellate and emergency-relief stages without treating a stay as a merits ruling.
